name: Maddaloni (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Maddaloni (a castle on light blue) within a wreath, with the inscription CITTA' DI MADDALONI in yellow arched above.
history: Municipal flag of Maddaloni, a comune in Campania; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Maddaloni arms — castle on light blue, crowned, within a wreath
inscription CITTA' DI MADDALONI arched above the arms
